description: This Java source file defines the PromotionsServiceClient class, which acts as an HTTP client to interact with a promotions service API. It provides a method to apply coupons by sending requests and handling responses, including exception management.

classes.name: PromotionsServiceClient
classes.description: Client component for communicating with the promotions service, including applying coupons and handling related exceptions.

classes.name: PromotionsServiceClient.PromotionsServiceClientException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating errors during interactions with the promotions service.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Sends a request to apply a coupon using the promotions service, propagating the caller’s JWT token. Handles responses and exceptions appropriately.
